title: Bar Salts Cola Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Embrace the nostalgic taste of Cola with Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Cola flavour concentrate. This 30ml bottle delivers the beloved, deep cola flavour with a 100% PG base, ideal for crafting a custom vape juice that hits all the right notes. Perfect for DIY enthusiasts, this flavour concentrate offers the freedom to create a unique e-liquid that reflects personal taste preferences. Adjust the flavour concentration and nicotine strength by mixing this concentrate with your preferred VG/PG base and Nic Shots. The recommended dilution for this concentrate is between 15-20%, tailored to achieve your desired flavour strength. Made in the UK with high-quality ingredients, this concentrate ensures a premium mixing experience. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
